gloss: from the standpoint of; in terms of; on

definitions.gloss: from the standpoint of; in terms of; as far as ... is concerned
definitions.explanation: Attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to name the perspective from which a statement holds: {法律上|ほうりつじょう} (legally speaking), {仕事上|しごとじょう} (in the course of work). Common in formal writing and business speech.

examples.japanese: {法律上|ほうりつじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
{仕事上|しごとじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つきあい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went out drinking as a work obligation.

examples.japanese: {性質上|せいしつじょう}、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: By its nature, this medicine must be kept in the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: {予算上|よさんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制約|せいやく}→制約：11811_seiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Because of budgetary constraints, we cannot buy new machinery this fiscal year.

notes:
Attaches directly to a Sino-Japanese noun with no particle. The resulting word behaves as a noun: it takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before another noun ({法律上|ほうりつじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧) and can stand adverbially at the head of a clause ({性質上|せいしつじょう}、…).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事上|しごとじょう}: in the course of work
- {法律上|ほうりつじょう}: legally, in legal terms
- {健康上|けんこうじょう}: for health reasons
- {計算上|けいさんじょう}: by calculation, on paper
- {都合上|つごうじょう}: for reasons of convenience or circumstance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: -ally — attaches more freely and is far less formal
- 〜⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in the aspect of — points to one facet among several rather than a viewpoint
